info.title: dbapi-transactions
info.description: Provides transactions information from your customer's savings and current accounts for the last 13 months.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Provides all transactions information from your customers' savings and current accounts for the last 13 months.

get.description: Reads transactions for cash accounts (current and deposit) for the given customer. The API provides in default up to 13 months of transaction history. If given IBAN is not valid or does not represent an account of the current customer, an empty result is returned. It is not apparent who issued a transaction, only whether the user gained or lost money by it (based on whether the amount is positive or negative respectively). The maximum number of transactions returned is 200.

parameters.name: iban
parameters.description: IBAN representing an account of the current user.

parameters.name: bookingDateFrom
parameters.description: booking date of original transaction. Date in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD. If not provided, 1980-01-01 will be chosen if called with a PSD2-compliant strong customer authentication (SCA), or the date prior to today with a maximum PSD2-compliant daycount if not called with a PSD2-compliant SCA. Please note that choosing a date too far into the past might lead to an error response if the result set would become too big. In this case narrowing the interval can help.

parameters.name: bookingDateTo
parameters.description: booking date until which the transactions to be searched for. Date in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. If not provided, the current day will be chosen. bookingDateTo must be greater than or equal to bookingDateFrom.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: sort order of transactions - supported sort orders are 'bookingDate[ASC]' or 'bookingDate[DESC]'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit defines count of resources per request/page.

parameters.name: Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Free form key controlled by the caller e.g. uuid

id.description: The id of the requested transaction. This id is NOT immutable and is to be used primarily in conjunction with the transaction notification API when requesting a specific transaction.

message.description: Description of the belonging error code.

messageId.description: dbAPI internal message-id (unique identifier) that allow reference to each of your API calls.

amount.description: Amount of the transaction. If the amount is positive, the customer received money, if the amount is negative the customer lost money.

bookingDate.description: Booking date. In the format YYYY-MM-DD.

externalBankTransactionDomainCode.description: Specifies the bank transaction code domain, as published in an external bank transaction code domain code list according to ISO 20022.

externalBankTransactionFamilyCode.description: Specifies the external family code of the bank transaction code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters according to ISO 20022.

externalBankTransactionSubFamilyCode.description: Specifies the bank transaction code sub-family, as published in an external bank transaction code sub-family code list according to ISO 20022.

mandateReference.description: MandateReference of the direct debit transaction, max length 35 characters.

e2eReference.description: Unique identification given by the orderer to identify the order.

paymentIdentification.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of a transaction, as assigned by any of the customer parties on the initiating side.

valueDate.description: Value date of Transaction in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). In very specific cases, technical date is possible for e.g., (2020-02-30).

uniqueTag.description: Unique tag of the transaction. It is a stable identifier for a single transaction and can be used to distinguish it from other transactions over time. It cannot be used to retrieve transaction data by id; use the 'id' property for that.
